title: Joash Crowned King

questions.question: Who took courage and made a covenant with the commanders?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 23:1 (ESV): "But in the seventh year Jehoiada took courage and entered into a covenant with the commanders..."

questions.question: What did Jehoiada show the assembly?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 23:3 (ESV): "...And Jehoiada said to them, 'Behold, the king's son! Let him reign...'"

questions.question: What did they give the new king upon crowning him?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 23:11 (ESV): "Then they brought out the king's son and put the crown on him and gave him the testimony..."

questions.question: What did the people shout?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 23:11 (ESV): "...And they shouted, 'Long live the king!'"

questions.question: What did Athaliah cry out when she saw the scene?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 23:13 (ESV): "...Then Athaliah tore her clothes and cried, 'Treason! Treason!'"

questions.question: Where was Athaliah killed?
options: At the Horse Gate of the king's house
questions.correctAnswer: At the Horse Gate of the king's house
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 23:15 (ESV): "...and when she had reached the entrance of the Horse Gate of the king's house, they put her to death there."

questions.question: Why did Jehoiada say not to kill her in the temple?
options: Do not put her to death in the house of the LORD
questions.correctAnswer: Do not put her to death in the house of the LORD
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 23:14 (ESV): "...For the priest said, 'Do not put her to death in the house of the LORD.'"

questions.question: What covenant did Jehoiada make between himself, the people, and the king?
options: That they should be the LORD's people
questions.correctAnswer: That they should be the LORD's people
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 23:16 (ESV): "And Jehoiada made a covenant between himself and all the people and the king that they should be the LORD's people."

questions.question: What temple did the people tear down?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 23:17 (ESV): "Then all the people went to the house of Baal and tore it down..."

questions.question: Who was the priest of Baal that they killed?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 23:17 (ESV): "...and they killed Mattan the priest of Baal before the altars."

questions.question: Who wielded the spears and shields that had been King David's?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 23:9 (ESV): "And Jehoiada the priest gave to the captains of hundreds the spears... that had been King David's..."

questions.question: What was the arrangement for the Levites and priests?
options: Jehoiada posted watchmen... under the direction of the Levitical priests and the Levites whom David had organized
questions.correctAnswer: Jehoiada posted watchmen... under the direction of the Levitical priests and the Levites whom David had organized
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 23:18 (ESV): "And Jehoiada posted watchmen... under the direction of the Levitical priests..."

questions.question: How did the city react after Athaliah's death?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 23:21 (ESV): "So all the people of the land rejoiced, and the city was quiet after Athaliah had been put to death with the sword."

questions.question: Who stood by the pillar at the entrance?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 23:13 (ESV): "And she looked, and behold, the king standing by his pillar at the entrance..."

questions.question: What musical instruments are mentioned?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 23:13 (ESV): "...and the singers with their instruments for song leading the praise."

key_verse_text: And Jehoiada made a covenant between himself and all the people and the king that they should be the LORD’s people.
